text:
maya: FYI - ACME Inc reported that their 500 trial credits from promo NEWUSER500 never showed in their active workspace (org_acme_123). Instead the credits landed on a legacy 'acme-old' workspace (org_acme_999). Can CS/billing investigate?

samir: Hmm, this smells like SSO migration artifacts. Do we have the promo grant event ID or request id?

maya: Customer pasted this billing event payload:
```json
{
  "event": "grant_applied",
  "promo": "NEWUSER500",
  "email": "ops@acme.com",
  "workspace_id": "org_acme_999",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-10T15:22:10Z",
  "request_id": "req_5b9f"
}
```

jordan: I'll pull ledger entries for req_5b9f. Customer says they had an SSO-based org merge last month and there are two workspace records with the same primary_email.

cs_bot: Note: billing-worker v2.3.0 behavior: when canonical org lookup by external_id fails, fallback = lookup_by_primary_email -> returns the first matched workspace. This can attach grants to a leftover legacy workspace if records weren't consolidated. Filing telemetry alert.

samir: Quick repro I ran locally to confirm:
1) create workspace A (primary_email ops@acme.com)
2) create workspace B (same primary_email) after SSO canonicalization
3) invoke promo grant flow supplying only email or a stale external_org_id
Commands:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/events/grant -d '{"email":"ops@acme.com","promo":"NEWUSER500","external_org_id":"missing_ext"}'
```
Result: credits applied to the first workspace (A) returned by email lookup. I'll open a GH issue for the fallback.

maya: Can billing move the credits from org_acme_999 -> org_acme_123? Customer is blocked from launching a paid experiment.

billing: Starting manual correction. Created adjustment adj_20260310_01, transfer request trf_7890. I'll post update when ledger entries settle (should be ~30m). Also placed a temporary hold on the credits in acme-old so they don't get consumed.

jordan: Suggest adding a guard: promo grants must resolve to canonical_org (external_id) or fail loudly. @ivan can you disable the email-fallback for promo grants?

ivan: Willing to do a safety-first change: disallow email-only resolution for promo grants and return 422 if canonical lookup fails. Rolling to staging now for a 1h smoke test, then prod.

maya: Customer updated — they're grateful. I've linked the internal ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CUST-4321 (will attach logs).

billing: adj_20260310_01 posted and transfer trf_7890 completed. Customer notified and balance on org_acme_123 now shows +500 credits. :white_check_mark:

maya: Closing loop with customer, will reopen if anything else crops up. :thumbsup:
